service.en: 60-day visa for certain nationals living abroad
service.ar: تأشيرة 60 يومًا لمواطني دول محددة المقيمين بالخارج
service.ur: بیرون ملک مقیم مخصوص ممالک کے شہریوں کے لیے 60 دن کا ویزا
service.ml: വിദേശത്ത് താമസിക്കുന്ന ചില രാജ്യക്കാർക്കുള്ള 60 ദിവസ വിസ

about: Get a 60-day entry visa if you hold a passport from a listed country and a visa or residence permit from a listed country.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Ordinary passports from India, Kenya, Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, the Philippines and South Africa, plus family members
Must hold a valid visa or residence permit from the US, EU or UK, or a residence permit from Japan, South Korea, Australia, Canada, Singapore or New Zealand; India also accepts a US Green Card
Passport valid for at least 6 months
documents: Copy of the visa, residence permit or Green Card
timing: Valid 30 days before entry; stay 60 days from entry
channels: ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS)
